decision.outcome: A — Timing defect confirmed and bounded prototype corrected

eventFedFailureCause.modeGetterDefect: The runtime supplied an eventFed getter inside an object spread; spreading evaluated it once before event configuration and left the adapter with a stale false boolean. The corrected readEventFedMode function and readRequest(eventFedMode) share the same runtime latch sample.
eventFedFailureCause.lateRequestCause: finishCycle(89) captures publication authority only for an already-present request scoped to cycle 90. D-late is installed at p719 after that finish, so cycle 90 receives the exact request but no source-backed cycle-89 publication identity.

arms.C: P53 direct request lookup through Construction-owned admission.
arms.D-early: Event-fed request delivered at p700 before cycle 89 finishes.
arms.D-late: Event-fed request delivered at p719 after cycle 89 finishes; expected fail-closed rejection.

chronology.minimumLeadTime: The P53 request must be installed before cycle 89's successful finish so that finish can capture the source-backed publication identity scoped to cycle 90. The contract specifies no fixed number of game periods: D-early arrived 12 periods before the finish at p712; D-late arrived 7 periods afterward and failed closed.

preIntervention.boundary: p719, before the cycle-90 Quarry decision at p720

annotation.text: Conflicts with city-farm for Lumber, Stone (Saving)

workerAllocationVsNoRequestA.interpretation: The ordinary native Quarry build initializes its native job controls identically in C and D-early. P52 only observes and correlates the resulting owner receipt; it has no Jobs execution authority.
